design_vision: High-density, API-first headless electronics e-commerce platform. Challenges generic generic storefronts. Emphasizes urgent deal mechanics, deep merchandising, and five distinct switchable aesthetic identities. Mobile-first patterns for future Flutter app parity.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: No generic centered layouts. Use dense grid merchandising (Flipkart/Noon style).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Strict separation of concerns: UI components must be dumb. All data comes from mocked API service layers (JSON tokens/endpoints).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on headers/overlays that sit above content. Always use backdrop-blur or solid fills.

hyper_retail.name: Hyper Retail (Default)
hyper_retail.vibe: High density, flash sales, urgent, Flipkart/Noon inspired.

cyber_neon.name: Cyber Neon
cyber_neon.vibe: Dark mode, gamer, futuristic, glowing edges.

homepage_layouts.name: The Mega Mall
homepage_layouts.structure: Sticky Header + Mega Menu -> Hero Deal Carousel -> Category Circles (Horizontal Scroll) -> Flash Sale Timer Section -> 3-Column Product Rails -> 'More Like This' Infinite Grid.

homepage_layouts.name: The Bento Showcase
homepage_layouts.structure: Asymmetric Grid (col-span-8, col-span-4). No sliders. One massive hero product block surrounded by smaller deal blocks. Editorial and dense.

homepage_layouts.name: The Flash Sale Frenzy
homepage_layouts.structure: Countdown timers everywhere. Horizontal scrolling rails that auto-play. Heavy use of badges (50% OFF, ONLY 2 LEFT). Urgent micro-interactions.

homepage_layouts.name: The Category Pillar
homepage_layouts.structure: Vertical left sidebar for categories (dashboard style). Right 75% of screen is an endless feed of mixed electronics products and promotional banners.

homepage_layouts.name: The Immersive Hero
homepage_layouts.structure: Large parallax hero showing a flagship product. Below it, a sleek 4-column grid of top-rated items with glassmorphism product cards.

product_card.style: Dense, compact. Must include: Image, Brand, Truncated Title, Rating Stars, Current Price, Strikethrough Old Price, Discount Badge, and an 'Add to Cart' quick button.
product_card.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase. Quick-view icon appears on image hover.

category_rail.style: Horizontal scrolling container. Hide scrollbars but indicate swipeability. Items should be circular or squircle with an icon/image and label below.

deal_countdown.style: High contrast block. Use monospaced font for numbers. E.g., 02 : 14 : 59 (Hrs:Min:Sec).

auth_modal.style: OTP-first design. Tabs for 'Email/Password' and 'Phone OTP'. Large input fields, clear focus states.

admin_panel.style: High density data grids. Sidebar navigation. Cardless tables for maximum data visibility. Theme selector widget to toggle active storefront theme globally.

delivery_partner_dashboard.style: Mobile-first layout. Large touch targets. Real-time simulated map or status timeline (Pending, Picked Up, In Transit, Delivered). Clear 'Mark as Delivered' CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent.routing_and_views: Create a unified React application with React Router. Include routes for: Home (with layout toggles), Product Listing, Product Detail, Cart, Checkout, Auth, Admin Dashboard, and Delivery Partner Dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Implement themes using CSS variables updated via a central React Context or Zustand store. Map the JSON design tokens directly to root variables so the entire app restyles instantly.
instructions_to_main_agent.homepage_switcher: In the Admin panel (or via a floating debug toggle), allow the user to switch between the 5 homepage layouts and 5 themes on the fly.
instructions_to_main_agent.api_mocking: Strict headless requirement: Do NOT couple logic into components. Create a `services/api.js` file that mocks REST/OpenAPI endpoints for products, auth (OTP), and orders. The UI should just call these async functions.
instructions_to_main_agent.mobile_ready: Ensure the Delivery Partner view and Auth flows (OTP) feel like a native mobile app. Use tight spacing, bottom sheets (where appropriate), and avoid desktop-only hover dependencies.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Dense e-commerce grids only.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). It disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles relevant to the active theme with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use phosphour or lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing inside containers with borders to prevent text collision.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing Shadcn components from src/components/ui.
